messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up 1wk sprint: we want a short credit blitz tied to the dev webinar. Goal = boost first-run completions and collect prompt feedback.
Leo: Love it. Size? Two arms?
Maya: Test small (300 tokens) vs large (1000 tokens). Canary 50 ppl each. Full run up to 3k.
Zoe: Routing propose: if account_tier == 'enterprise' or intent_score > 0.7 -> SDR; else auto-enroll into webinar + onboarding email. Webhook must pass variant and credit_code.
Kai: I'll add events: credit_awarded, prompt_pack_installed, first_completion. Dashboard: compare variants on 24h activation. Quick SQL stub: `SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(first_completion::int) FROM events WHERE credit_awarded AND event_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-07' GROUP BY variant;`
PromoBot: Reminder: landing page needs `data-test=credit_blitz_v1` and GA param `utm_campaign=credit_blitz_v1` before deploy (48h).
Maya: Copy draft for social: "Join our live dev workshop 10am PT. Get credits + curated prompt packs to ship prototypes faster." CTA: "Reserve seat & claim credits"
Leo: A/B copy: Variant A mentions 'prompt packs', Variant B only 'credits' — tag as blitz_A/B. We'll track CTR -> registration -> first-run.
Zoe: I'll wire the webhook and add retry on failure.
Maya: Owners: Leo social, Zoe routing, Kai metrics. Reconvene tomorrow 9am PT for final go/no-go.
